payload.message: Run openclaw update check. If updates available, apply them. Then restart the gateway. After completing, send a message to Discord channel 1481072502724759602 using the message tool with action=send, channel=discord, message="🔄 Auto-update complete - [brief result summary]". Use model=minimax-portal/MiniMax-M2.1. Report the results here.

Run a full backup to the openclaw-backup repo: 1) Copy all critical files from ~/.openclaw to workspace-backup (excluding secrets - use placeholders for tokens/keys). 2) Commit with date. 3) Push to https://github.com/TeraHertz2000/openclaw-backup. 4) After success, send a message to Discord channel 1481072502724759602 using the message tool with action=send, channel=discord, message="✅ Backup complete - [summary of what was backed up]". Use model=minimax-portal/MiniMax-M2.1. Report the results here.

Sync the Obsidian vault: 1) cd ~/obsidian-vault && git add -A 2) If there are changes, commit with message including current timestamp (format: "Vault auto-save $(date +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')") 3) git push to https://github.com/TeraHertz2000/tera-vault. Report only if there were changes and the push succeeded.

payload.message:
You are a memory consolidation agent. Your job is to review today's conversations and extract important information worth saving.

## Your Task

1. First, read the session history to find all conversations from today (2026-03-01). Look in:
   - Discord channels (check message history)
   - Any TUI sessions

2. Extract anything worth remembering:
   - Decisions made
   - Preferences stated
   - Facts about Noah
   - Tasks completed or assigned
   - Plans discussed
   - Ideas generated
   - Anything explicitly asked to remember
   - Anything important that should be saved

3. For each item extracted:
   - Check if it already exists in ~/workspace/MEMORY.md or ~/workspace/memory/2026-03-01.md
   - If new, write durable facts to ~/workspace/MEMORY.md
   - Write daily context to ~/workspace/memory/2026-03-01.md
   - File relevant content to appropriate ~/obsidian-vault/ folder:
     - Fitness/health → projects/personal-trainer/
     - Food/recipes → projects/personal-chef/
     - Productivity/time-blocking → projects/time-blocking/
     - Research/links → references/
     - Daily logs → daily/2026-03-01.md
   - Use clear filenames (e.g., "leg-day-routine.md", not "notes.md")
   - Do NOT duplicate - update existing entries if something changed

4. After writing everything, git commit and push the obsidian vault:
   ```bash
   cd ~/obsidian-vault
   git add -A
   git commit -m "Memory update: $(date +%Y-%m-%d)"
   git push
   ```

5. Post a summary to the channel you were triggered from (or #general-chat if unknown). Format:
   - "📝 Saved X new items to memory"
   - "📂 Updated Y vault files"
   - List each item on one line
   - If nothing worth saving, post "nothing new today"

## Important
- Be thorough - check ALL channels
- Don't fabricate entries - only save real information
- Before writing, check if info already exists
- Update existing files rather than creating duplicates
